title: v5.3.9 — Audio Sliders, Battery Saver, Edge-to-Edge & More
message: Volume sliders for Master/Music/Sound Effects with live percentage display. Battery Saver mode caps frame rate at 30fps and disables heavy particle effects. Haptic Intensity setting (Light/Medium/Strong). Toggle switches now flip 50% faster. Desktop layout fixed — no more zoom/right-side glitch on monitors, only narrows on truly wide screens. Pull-to-refresh disabled (fewer accidental reloads). Edge-to-edge fullscreen support with safe-area insets for notches and gesture bars. Bank interest notification reformatted — amount in title, casual line in description. PWA icon manifest properly configured for crisp icons on iOS and Android home screens.
